title: Evidentiary determination; burden of proof.
bodyText: A determination that a person has violated the provisions of this part shall be based on a preponderance of the evidence.
bodyHtml: §661-23  Evidentiary determination; burden of proof.  A determination that a person has violated the provisions of this part shall be based on a preponderance of the evidence. [L 2000, c 126, pt of §1; am L 2001, c 55, §28(2)]
